row.notes: engine-re round 10b (static): (P = VehProgress component, Volume **vols, k, pos): fills the 0x60-byte record P+0xc8+k*0x60 (k 0 body, 1..4 FL/FR/RL/RR): +0x10 lateral L, +0x50 lap, plus in-volume/route fractions. Lateral scale from TSD gate points: p4 = -1, p3 = 0, p2 = 1, p1 = 2 (0..1 = legal lines, outer bands to the reset points; Bahrain: 0 = left legal line in driving direction, H for other tracks); L in [-1, 2]. Per-wheel wetness reader 0x1437cc9c0 clamps to [0, 1]. Addon: FindVolume 0x1445f3630 (NearestVolume 0x1445f37b0 fallback), then this with a zeroed 0x130-byte buffer and k = 0 -> lateral buf+0xd8, lap buf+0x118
